title: Designing Markets for Screening: Optimal Composition and the Geometry of Surplus
abstract: arXiv:2604.09340v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We characterize the structure of market compositions that generate Pareto efficient outcomes and the geometry of the surplus set in a screening model with type-dependent costs. Under mild cost-curvature conditions, agent-oriented optima use rather than suppress screening to sustain information rents: all agents are served, allocations strictly separate types, and an atom at the highest type receives the efficient allocation. Each Pareto efficient payoff is implemented by a unique market. When costs are type independent or a type with no gains from trade is feasible, we also characterize the entire surplus set and establish its convexity. Otherwise, type-dependent costs can generate nonconvexity. Market segmentation can expand attainable outcomes only on the rent-suppression side of the set, without increasing maximum agent surplus at any level of principal surplus. translated_title: 为甄别而设计市场：最优构成与剩余的几何结构
translated_abstract: 我们在一个具有类型依赖成本的甄别模型中，刻画了能够产生帕累托有效结果的市场构成结构以及剩余集的几何形状。在温和的成本曲率条件下，面向代理人的最优解是利用而非抑制甄别来维持信息租金：所有代理人都得到服务，配置严格区分不同类型，且位于最高类型处的原子获得有效配置。每一个帕累托有效收益都由唯一的市场实现。当成本与类型无关，或存在一个没有贸易收益的类型时，我们还刻画了整个剩余集并证明其凸性。否则，类型依赖的成本可能导致非凸性。市场分割只能在剩余集中租金抑制的一侧扩展可实现的结果，并且在任何委托人剩余水平上都不会增加代理人的最大剩余。该刻画与比较静态分析将市场形成与（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在具有类型依赖成本的甄别模型中刻画了产生帕累托有效结果的最优市场构成及剩余集的几何结构，证明每个帕累托有效收益由唯一市场实现，且市场分割只能在租金抑制一侧扩展结果而不提高代理人的最大剩余。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the optimal market composition generating Pareto efficient outcomes and the geometry of the surplus set in a screening model with type-dependent costs, showing that each Pareto efficient payoff is implemented by a unique market and that market segmentation can expand attainable outcomes only on the rent-suppression side without increasing maximum agent surplus.
